playbooks.title: Fuel anomaly investigation
playbooks.summary: Correlate sensor quality and drain pattern into a hypothesis case; never accuse.

playbooks.title: Alert triage
playbooks.summary: Group duplicate alerts, check freshness, propose case/task/notification with idempotency.

playbooks.title: Maintenance workflow
playbooks.summary: Turn mileage and engine hours into a proposed task with deterministic evidence.

playbooks.title: Daily fleet briefing
playbooks.summary: Offline vehicles, alerts, fuel, utilisation, maintenance, overdue cases, data-quality gaps.

playbooks.title: Driver message draft
playbooks.summary: Neutral safety language, minimum location, approval required; emergencies to human dispatch.

playbooks.title: Route and geofence optimisation
playbooks.summary: Proposal and simulation only; product validates geometry before any apply.
